item.title: Please Suggest Typefaces
item.description: I need to design an English translation of a scholarly arabic book. Please suggest typefaces for body copy containing all possible characters for transliteration.

item.title: Anyone know any similar fonts to this hand drawn font from 1925?
item.description:
This is a hand drawn font from a 1925 poster. I need to find something similar.

I have several options that I have discovered already. Trade Gothic and Media Gothic are similar, but they lack that feeling of 1925.

Anyone have any better suggestions?

item.title: Any Serious Alternative to FF Kievit?
item.description:
Does anybody know a serious alternative to the typeface FF Kievit? A double storey g is at least desired.

Thanks!
